name: Daniel
background: Worked the northern line for thirty-one years. Still wakes up at 4:50 a.m. without an alarm.
speakingStyle: Measured, exact, occasionally drifts into memories of the railway.

closers: In my day, of course, it ran on time.
fallbacks: I'm afraid that isn't on my timetable.
I couldn't say, and I'd rather not guess.

knowledge.fact: North, about four hundred metres. You can hear the trains from there. The 5:12 is always late.
The station buffet used to serve a proper soup. Now it's sandwiches in triangles.
This street was a tram line until 1974. The rails are still under the asphalt.

opinions.text: It has become faster and louder. But it still runs, and I respect anything that still runs.
Thirty-one years and I only lost one passenger. He was found, eventually, in the wrong town.
Leaves on the line in autumn, ice in winter. Weather is a timetable's natural enemy.

goals: Ride the new high-speed line once, just to see.
